title: Cloud walk
brief: Fictional cream sneaker in a surreal cloud landscape, no performance claim.
prompt: Square 1:1 high-end surreal footwear advertising photograph. One beautifully crafted unbranded cream low-top sneaker with terracotta suede heel tab and cream laces is the hero, large but fully visible, resting on a small sculptural cloud as though it is a floating pedestal. Peach dawn sky, distant soft clouds, tiny terracotta arch far below suggesting playful scale. Physically detailed shoe with believable stitching, rubber sole and laces; all surrealism is in the environment. Soft directional cinematic light, clean visual hierarchy. No logo, no text, no wings, no people, no watermark. One standalone original conceptual campaign image.
usage: Use for brand awareness ads, campaign headers or mood-led social posts. Keep it out of evidence-led product demonstrations and marketplace main images.

title: Tea planet
brief: Fictional unbranded matcha tea cup as a small planet; illustration of a ritual, no health claims.
prompt: Square 1:1 premium surreal still-life campaign. A single pale celadon ceramic tea cup filled with vivid matcha floats at the center like a tiny planet. A narrow elegant ring of loose tea leaves orbits the cup without obscuring its silhouette; deep midnight teal backdrop, one subtle warm sun-like light off frame creates realistic highlights in the ceramic and liquid. A tiny soft cloud behind, restrained elegant impossible scene with exact realistic materials. The cup handle is visible on the right; matcha surface flat within the cup. No brand, no text, no health promises, no watermark. Original standalone commercial concept, not a collage.
usage: Use for brand awareness ads, campaign headers or mood-led social posts. Keep it out of evidence-led product demonstrations and marketplace main images.
